_comment: Machine-readable folder ownership. OWNER: integrator (main only). Read by tools/ci/check_ownership.py (git pre-commit hook + CI) and tools/ci/agent_guard.py (Claude Code PreToolUse hook). Globs: ** = any depth, * = within one folder.

exclude._comment: Extended-tier dishes belong to the data-dishes helper, so P1 and the helper never edit the same file.

locked._comment: After the lock tag exists, these paths may not change on ANY branch unless ALLOW_LOCKED=1 (integrator, with team agreement; then move the tag: git tag -f sanity-lock).
